data_directory.name: Data directory
data_directory.description: Where login cookies, webhooks and proxies are stored. Keep /config/zalo_bot unless you have a reason to change it — changing it loses the Zalo session and you must scan the QR code again.

session_secret.name: Session signing key
session_secret.description: Can be left EMPTY: the add-on generates a key unique to this machine and keeps it, so logins survive restarts. Fill this in only if you want to manage the key yourself. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

admin_password.name: Admin password
admin_password.description: Can be left EMPTY: the add-on generates a random password, writes it to THONG-TIN-DANG-NHAP.txt in the data directory (open it with the File editor or Samba) and prints it to the Log tab on every start. Fill this in to choose your own.

api_key.name: Send API key
api_key.description: RECOMMENDED. If left empty, any machine on your local network can call the sending APIs (/api/sendmessage, /api/findUser…) without logging in — meaning they can send messages from your Zalo account. Setting a key closes that. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
